column1: # What Phiogy is to appkit: its name, what Phiora knows it by, the
# host in front on a mobile
# window, the host shown in the bar's menu, the space a room is shown
# in, whether the spaces are shown as tabs over the body, the person's
# own folder for Phiogy and the file there what they chose is kept in.
name
key
front
side
space
tab
folder
setting
# The web Phiogy's own file, which names its hosts and its rooms and
# the files that say more of them: from this crate's folder. Phiogy
# asks Phiora for this document first (`data/phiora.tsv`) and reads
# the file where Phiora does not answer; the files it names are read
# from beside it either way, and nothing of them is copied.
# `phiogy --site` and a path reads another file, and asks nobody.
site
# The app's server, for everybody who runs Phiogy on any machine (the
# user, 25 November 2026: "for the webrtc and calls will use
# phiegg.com/wrt|cdn etc for now"): Phiora under `server.phiora`, the
# line the calls are on under `server.line`, the web Phiogy's own file
# under `server.site`, and pictures by their keys (data/asset.tsv). A
# file or a picture that is on this disk is read from here; one that is
# not, from the server. `--local` keeps to this machine: Phiora where
# data/phiora.tsv's `here` says, and a line served here.
server
server.phiora
server.line
server.site
server.web
# The setting of the system that holds a password for `phiogy
# --signin`, so none is ever a word of a command line.
secret
# The spaces that stand with no menu beside the bar: the library is its
# own two columns, its tree and what is in it; an item opened from it
# stands beside its inspector.
bare
# The tabs over the guide's rooms, in order.
guide
